history.content: feeling kinda numb today i guess
That sounds a bit numb or blank today. Does it feel more like nothing is there, or like it’s out of reach?
out of reach maybe. like hes right there but i dont feel anything
Out of reach makes sense here — like he’s right there, but nothing is landing. Does it feel more like foggy, shut down, or just very far away?
shut down i think. we used to talk all night now i just sit there
Shut down fits the shape you’re describing — used to talking all night, now just sitting there. Did something happen before it went quiet, or does it just feel like everything went flat?
idk. nothing big. he asked about my day and i just had nothing to say. felt like a stranger
That sounds disconnected, almost like the distance showed up as “a stranger.” Does it feel more blank, or more like you pulled back?
pulled back probably. anyway thats it. just wanted to get it down

Of course — I’ll leave it here. Thanks for saying it so plainly.
